name: inFlow Inventory
description_en:
inFlow Inventory manages inventory, purchases, sales and fulfillment across locations, with mobile and barcode workflows. Its product family now distinguishes Inventory, Manufacturing and Stockroom.

Inventory is the relevant option for wholesale, distribution and field-service stock with sales or purchasing needs. Manufacturing adds assembly/BOM operations, while the simpler Stockroom product focuses on scan-in/scan-out consumables and explicitly omits reordering, costing and sales.
description_zh:
inFlow Inventory 管理跨地点的库存、采购、销售与履约，提供移动及条码流程。当前产品线区分 Inventory、Manufacturing 和 Stockroom。

需要销售或采购的批发、分销和现场服务库存可评估 Inventory。Manufacturing 增加组装和物料清单流程；更简单的 Stockroom 面向耗材扫码进出，明确不含补货、成本和销售。

core_features.explanation_zh: Inventory 描述地点转移、盘点、收货、销售履约及补货设置。

core_features.explanation_en: The product describes label design and scanning; Showroom exposes a customer-facing B2B catalog/order portal with plan-dependent pricing.

sections.title_en: Check replenishment and fulfillment by location
sections.title_zh: 按地点检查补货与履约
sections.en: Create product and location records, receive stock, transfer it to a satellite site and fulfill a sale. Compare on-hand quantities and reorder notifications at each location. If lot, serial or expiry traceability is required, test it explicitly with the paid entitlement enabled. Product-level availability claims do not mean every entry plan includes all traceability modules.
sections.zh: 创建商品和地点记录，收货后转移至分支地点再销售履约，比较各地现存量与补货通知。如需批次、序列号或有效期追溯，应启用相应付费权限后专门测试。整体产品宣传不代表所有入门方案包含全部追溯模块。

sections.title_en: Choose the product before the subscription tier
sections.title_zh: 先选产品，再选订阅级别
sections.en: Inventory Lite/Core/Pro/Max show annual-billed USD monthly equivalents of $99/$299/$499/$699. Included teams are 2/5/10/20 members; locations are one without sublocations, five, then unlimited for the top two tiers. Manufacturing starts at $169 annually billed per-month equivalent and includes Inventory features. Standalone Stockroom starts at $69 on the same advertised annual basis.
sections.zh: Inventory Lite/Core/Pro/Max 的年付美元月均价为 $99/$299/$499/$699，含 2/5/10/20 成员；地点依次为一个且无子地点、五个、后两档不限。Manufacturing 年付月均从 $169 起并含 Inventory 功能；独立 Stockroom 同口径从 $69 起。

sections.title_zh: 计入附加模块、上线与硬件
sections.en: The calculator separately lists extra members/locations and plan-dependent add-ons for lots, serials, API/MCP and Showroom. The pricing text also shows a $499 one-time onboarding package with optional/required treatment varying by plan; confirm the exact tier obligation. Hardware credits are new-customer credits, not included scanners. Do not assume unlimited sales/products/integrations removes all feature or capacity charges.
sections.zh: 计算器单列额外成员、地点，以及按方案收费的批次、序列号、API/MCP 和 Showroom。价格文字还显示一次性 $499 上线包，按方案有可选与必需之分，需确认具体义务。硬件抵用额面向新客户，不代表包含扫描设备。销售、商品、集成不限不等于所有功能及容量免费。

sections.title_en: Exercise accounting and regional payment boundaries
sections.title_zh: 检查会计与地区支付边界
sections.en: The product offers a 14-day no-card trial and names QuickBooks Online/Xero financial connections. Showroom online payment is described for the US and Canada, so other regions should confirm alternatives. Test canceled orders, a transfer discrepancy and connector retries before migration. No live payment, API connection or mobile scan was performed.
sections.zh: 产品提供无需信用卡的 14 天试用，并列出 QuickBooks Online/Xero 财务连接。Showroom 在线支付说明面向美国和加拿大，其他地区应确认替代方式。迁移前应测试取消订单、转移差异和连接重试。未实际支付、连接 API 或移动扫描。
